conditions: A notice placed by the file's copyright holder states that GPLv3 and this exception govern the given file.
limitations: This claim states the opening file-level applicability condition. Eligibility to propagate or convey a particular combination under the additional permission requires separate section 1 analysis.
The claim supplies no project-wide grant, future GPL edition ruling, or canonical base-license relationship.

statement: The exception text shipped in GCC 14.2.0 states that GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 is an additional permission under GNU GPL version 3 section 7 and applies to a given file when its copyright holder's notice states that GPLv3 and this exception govern the file.
